title: Hacker group that breached Rajasthan Police database claims it has FIR & call detail records | An investigation is underway to verify the claims. | Inshorts
text:
Hacker group that breached Rajasthan Police database claims it has FIR & call detail records 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Hacker group that breached Rajasthan Police database claims it has FIR & call detail records
 short by Jayant Singh / 01:45 pm on Saturday, 24 October, 2026 A hacker group identifying itself as 'ScarlettGroup' that claimed to have breached the databases of the Rajasthan Police has also claimed to have copies of first information reports (FIRs) and call detail records (CDRs). They also claimed to possess electronic Know Your Customer (e-KYC) records, witness statements and confidential information from senior police officers’ official email accounts. read more at Hindustan Times Inshorts Pte.
